speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin my investigation, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool consistency recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your weight loss and night sweats, I need to check for blood in your stool and assess your blood counts. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count and REQUEST TEST: Fecal_Occult_Blood. Have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL). The biopsy showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with massive lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly, confirms an aggressive B-cell lymphoma. I request images of the CT scan to further localize the extent of the disease for staging.
